svg.title: Prepare a release through a reviewed PR
svg.desc: Real release path, not --dry-run. Preparation stops at a release PR. Tag composition belongs to a qualified hosted publisher after merge and exact-head CI, never the interactive checkout. Actual endpoint: An exact published tag and declared asset inventory after authorization and read-back. When provenance is declared, retain the original receipt and merge its separate closeout PR; publication alone does not finish that record. Conditions and return paths remain in the companion reading view.

Manrope Variable, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Declare → derive → merge the release PR → publish

svg.title: Resolve and derive
svg.desc: command: /ca:release: select the declared target → skill: release: pre-flight and target resolution → skill: release: version derivation. A resolved target, target-scoped history and a derived identity. Missing declarations or required notes are explicit stops or governed back-fill.

path.title: declared owner: The command routes to the reusable release skill.
target scoped: Sibling target history must not bump this target.

g.title: /ca:release: select the declared target. Use the sole declared target or name the intended one. An unknown or ambiguous selection stops rather than choosing a familiar plugin or version.

g.title: release: pre-flight and target resolution. Resolve project and shell context, the declared row, clean non-default branch, current verification and relevant questions. A missing declaration uses confirmed back-fill, not a guessed row.

g.title: release: version derivation. Classify only the target’s payload window. Derive through its declared policy using compatible tags and manifests; required changelog notes come from actual commit evidence.

svg.title: Prepare the release PR
svg.desc: skill: release: declared manifests and changelog → skill: commit-gate: release changes → command: Ordinary PR procedure → agent: Applicable PR review and owner decision. The release PR describes committed surfaces, exact declared asset names and their reviewed hosted qualification path. Stop this invocation: no tag composition before merge.

path.title: gated persistence: Commit release edits through the existing gate.
mandatory PR: The release branch must use the PR route and stop this invocation.
review before merge: Apply the ordinary PR reviewer and merge requirements.

g.title: release: declared manifests and changelog. Update only declared surfaces and run the post-bump pre-tag checks. Report exact asset names and the hosted qualification path without executing release-build locally.

g.title: commit-gate: release changes. Commit the release edits through the existing permission, selected-file and evidence gate. A tag names a commit, never outstanding working-tree changes.

svg.title: Qualify the merged candidate
svg.desc: skill: release: bind the hosted candidate → skill: release: exact hosted inventory → skill: release: hosted annotated tag. A qualified hosted publisher identifies the exact fetched default-branch commit and green evidence. Missing capability, stale surfaces or asset mismatch stops publication.

path.title: qualified cohort: The exact merged candidate owns the package evidence.
before publication: The qualifying hosted publisher owns tag composition; the interactive agent does not run it locally.

g.title: release: bind the hosted candidate. After the release PR merges, a fresh hosted checkout must equal the fetched default branch and satisfy exact-head checks. Bind the current release section and every declared manifest.

g.title: release: exact hosted inventory. The reviewed publisher either builds the declared assets or verifies a retained exact-head CI cohort. Local scratch files do not cross the PR boundary as publication input.

g.title: release: hosted annotated tag. Classify the observed tag/release state, compose only when appropriate, and verify the stored tag message. An already-published identity is not replaced.

svg.title: Authorize, publish and retain proof
svg.desc: skill: release: consume explicit authorization → skill: release: inspect remote identities and assets → skill: release: retain the original receipt. Read back exact publication before cleanup. When a provenance manifest is declared, close its receipt through a separate PR rather than editing the hosted default branch.

path.title: verify the remote: A successful command alone is not proof of the remote inventory.
retain original evidence: Capture the original publication identity before disposing of positively identified scratch state.

g.title: release: consume explicit authorization. Only the declared publisher consumes the applicable one-cohort permission. An explicit merge instruction after the release-PR report can supply it for that protected publisher; CI success alone cannot.

g.title: release: inspect remote identities and assets. Read back the annotated tag, dereferenced commit, non-draft release and exact asset names. Preserve partial failure evidence instead of recreating published identities.

g.title: release: retain the original receipt. If declared, capture the original remote provenance and hand off a non-default-branch receipt PR. Closeout remains pending until that PR merges. With no declared manifest, say explicitly that this step is skipped.
